decision_answers.4. Copies or historical-cache replays: Yes. 39 CSV path(s) reproduce the champion prediction stream exactly; 76 byte-identical file duplicate group(s) and additional aligned-stream duplicates are listed. Other replay/cache labels are path clues, not proven lineage.
decision_answers.5. Independently trained candidate worth: No new candidate is recommended on correlation alone. The strongest verified fresh-run candidates are the rejected EXP07/EXP08 outputs; consult their OOF gates rather than rerunning or promoting by similarity.
decision_answers.6. OOF files not comparable to the test: 6 OOF prediction column(s) were identified and excluded; full paths and reasons are in CSV_INVENTORY.csv and ALIGNMENT_VALIDATION.csv.
decision_answers.7. Evidence of improved predictive perfo: No test-label or new leaderboard evidence exists in this audit. independently_trained_candidate_evidence.scope: A test CSV cannot prove training independence. Evidence is derived from saved folds/models/run summaries and related experiment documentation.

limitations: No test labels are used or available for the test-set comparison.
Correlation does not measure AUC or public leaderboard performance.
OOF prediction rows were not compared with the test champion.
Path-based provenance labels are conservative and do not by themselves prove a historical replay.
Pairwise Pearson and Spearman are emitted for unique aligned streams; pairwise Kendall is omitted as impractical at full pair coverage.
